title: "Untitled"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dlookr)
library(reshape2)
```


```{r}
gpt_long_cgt_filtered <- gpt_long_cgt%>%
 filter(!grepl("DBS", attribute))
gpt_long_cgt_filtered
```


```{r}
gpt_long_cgnt
```

```{r}
# Angenommen, deine Tabellen heißen tabelle1 und tabelle2
cgt_cgnt_gpt_combined <- bind_rows(gpt_long_cgt_filtered,gpt_long_cgnt)

# Ergebnis anzeigen
cgt_cgnt_gpt_combined
```


```{r}
gpt_long_f <- gpt_long %>% 
#  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Diclo") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(attribute, "_From Start|_From start|DBS"))
gpt_long_f
```



```{r}
# Beispiel: tabelle1 = Gruppe A, tabelle2 = Gruppe B
cgt_cgnt_gpt_combined_TTOq <- cgt_cgnt_gpt_combined %>%
  mutate(tto_group = "TTOq")

gpt_long_f_TTOd <- gpt_long_f %>%
  mutate(tto_group = "TTOd")

# Jetzt zusammenfügen
combined_table_gpt <- bind_rows(cgt_cgnt_gpt_combined_TTOq, gpt_long_f_TTOd)

combined_table_gpt
```


```{r}
library(dlookr)
combined_table_gpt %>% 
  group_by(tto_group) %>% 
  normality(labreads)
```


```{r}
t.test(
   labreads ~ tto_group,
  data = combined_table_gpt
)
```


```{r}
library(ggstatsplot)

all_patients_comparison_of_labvalues <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = combined_table_gpt,
  x = "tto_group",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",
  title = "all patients_comparison of labvalues", # ALT for labvalue and daily dose",
       xlab = "TTO group",
       ylab = "ALT u/l") 
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/all_patients_gpt_comparison_of_labvalues.svg", height = 8, width = 6.5)
print(all_patients_comparison_of_labvalues)
dev.off()
all_patients_comparison_of_labvalues
```

```{r}
t.test(
   labreads ~ tto_group,
  data = combined_table_inr
)
```


```{r}
library(ggstatsplot)

all_patients_comparison_of_labvalues <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = combined_table_inr,
  x = "tto_group",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",
  title = "all patients_comparison of labvalues", # inr for labvalue and daily dose",
       xlab = "TTO group",
       ylab = "inr") 
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/all_patients_inr_comparison_of_labvalues.svg", height = 8, width = 6.5)
print(all_patients_comparison_of_labvalues)
dev.off()
all_patients_comparison_of_labvalues
```
